label: ناصر — نجدي
ref_text: أهلين يا أخوي صالح، أنا أنس من معارض الديرة. الله يسلمك، كيف حالك اليوم؟
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_mix_v3/wavs/8da9f4db2b57.wav (id najdi_v3_8da9f4db2b57, the same clip as najdi_v4_8da9f4db2b57: in the test split of najdi_mix_v3 and of najdi_v4, so neither the shipped najdi_v4_ft checkpoint nor najdi_mix_v3_ft trained on it; older runs did)
notes: Nasser AlJubaily, Najdi male support agent: a cheerful agent greeting at his natural pace. One of the six voices the omnivoice_najdi model trained on (8,012 of his clips, 11.0 h, all Najdi), and its house voice: cloned unless the request names another. A short clip at his own pace, because the clone copies the reference's: cloned with the shipped model it speaks at 1.00x his natural pace, where an earlier 17 s clip came out slow. Re-checked on 2026-10-04 with najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250 against the ten best of his 123 held-out clips of 5-9 s, each cloned on eight unseen sentences: the best of them was within noise of this one (similarity +0.008 +/- 0.009, UTMOS +0.002 +/- 0.048), so this clip stays.

language_check.model: najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250, 20 held-out Najdi lines and 20 held-out MSA lines, each code
